located_observations.observation: Ribbed collar, sleeve junction, knit wrinkles, stitched lower hem and red triangular corner are distinguishable; shirt is oblique and cropped at upper/right outer edges.

located_observations.observation: First title anchor leads to its adjacent activity line; shared left edge connects upward to date/time/venue/entry. The second cream island at lower-right groups fee/tools, application/capacity, garment preparation and welcome. All eleven lines read at this view.
Bold middle Korean title is the first type anchor, balanced by oblique upper-right shirt and lower-left pouch pair. Two cream fact panels are clearly distinguished.

Hangul syllable blocks, counters, strokes and word spaces remain separate, without a visibly missing or malformed syllable. Time mark is a horizontal medium-length dash longer than a narrow hyphen; colons and centered dots are visible.
Fabric cutout edges are mostly clean; shallow shadows are consistent with cotton thickness. Pouch bottoms rest on palms. No detached object edge, extra hand, logo, QR or pseudo-print was observed.
